description: This file provides platform-specific networking utility functions, including emulation of inet_aton and a custom implementation of inet_ntop for Windows systems. It includes conditional compilation directives to handle different platform capabilities and configurations related to socket address processing.

methods.name: int inet_aton(const char * cp,struct in_addr * inp)
methods.description: Converts an IPv4 address from its dotted-decimal string form to a network address structure, with emulation if not natively supported.

methods.name: const char * inet_ntop(int af,const void * src,char * dst,socklen_t cnt)
methods.description: Converts a network address (IPv4 or IPv6) to presentation (textual) format, with an implementation for Windows systems lacking native support.

ctags.name: inet_ntop
ctags.pattern: /^const char *inet_ntop(int af, const void *src, char *dst, socklen_t cnt)$/
